mapper.select: SELECT LOWER(TRIM(unit)) unit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) current_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) previous_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM harvest_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND harvest_date>=#{previousStart} AND harvest_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(unit)) ORDER BY unit

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_net, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_net, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sales_date>=#{previousStart} AND sales_date<#{endExclusive}

SELECT LOWER(TRIM(unit)) unit,SUM(quantity) sold_quantity,SUM(gross_amount) gross_sales_amount FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sales_date>=#{start} AND sales_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(unit)) HAVING SUM(quantity)>0 ORDER BY unit

SELECT l.zone_id id,COALESCE(z.name,'미지정') name,LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) unit,SUM(l.quantity) quantity, COUNT(*) record_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.created_role='FARM_CARE_MANAGER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) manager_input_count FROM harvest_log l LEFT JOIN farm_zone z ON z.id=l.zone_id WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.harvest_date>=#{start} AND l.harvest_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY l.zone_id,z.name,LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) ORDER BY name,id,unit

SELECT l.variety_id id,COALESCE(v.name,'미지정') name,LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) unit,SUM(l.quantity) quantity, COUNT(*) record_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.created_role='FARM_CARE_MANAGER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) manager_input_count FROM harvest_log l LEFT JOIN crop_variety v ON v.id=l.variety_id WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.harvest_date>=#{start} AND l.harvest_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY l.variety_id,v.name,LOWER(TRIM(l.unit)) ORDER BY name,id,unit

SELECT l.customer_id id,COALESCE(c.name,'미지정') name,SUM(l.gross_amount) gross_sales_amount, SUM(l.fee_amount) fee_amount,SUM(l.net_amount) net_sales_amount,COUNT(*) record_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.created_role='FARM_CARE_MANAGER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) manager_input_count FROM sales_log l LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.farm_id=l.farm_id AND c.id=l.customer_id WHERE l.farm_id=#{farmId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.sales_date>=#{start} AND l.sales_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY l.customer_id,c.name ORDER BY name,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm f JOIN farm_member fm ON fm.farm_id=f.id AND fm.user_id=#{userId} WHERE f.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND fm.role='FARM_OWNER' AND fm.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT f.id farm_id,f.name farm_name FROM farm f JOIN farm_member fm ON fm.farm_id=f.id AND fm.user_id=#{userId} WHERE f.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND fm.role='FARM_OWNER' AND fm.status='ACTIVE' AND f.status='ACTIVE' AND f.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.id

SELECT farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) unit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) current_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) previous_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN harvest_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM harvest_log WHERE farm_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND harvest_date>=#{previousStart} AND harvest_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY farm_id,LOWER(TRIM(unit)) ORDER BY farm_id,unit

SELECT farm_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) current_net, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_gross, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN fee_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_fee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),0) previous_net, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date>=#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sales_date<#{currentStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) previous_count FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sales_date>=#{previousStart} AND sales_date<#{endExclusive} GROUP BY farm_id ORDER BY farm_id
